name: bookmark-sync
description: AI bookmark curation, link health, and safe cross-browser sync workspace

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:browser && npm run build:storage && npm run build:extension && npm run build:server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run build:browser && npm run build:storage && npm run typecheck:packages
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck --workspace @bookmark-sync/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @bookmark-sync/browser-adapters && npm run typecheck --workspace @bookmark-sync/storage-adapters && npm run typecheck --workspace @bookmark-sync/extension && npm run typecheck --workspace @bookmark-sync/server
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run build:browser && npm run build:storage && vitest run packages/core/src/core.test.ts packages/storage-adapters/src/storage.test.ts packages/storage-adapters/src/webdav.test.ts packages/browser-adapters/src/chromium.test.ts
